items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: reggae to me sounds like early Fat Domino

ctx.x: Do you think there's much to the theory that a lot of reggae originally had its roots in New Orleans music?

I don't really know what came first, but to my own knowledge, reggae to me sounds like early Fat Domino. Mm-hmm. And things like that. So, yes, in that way. Mm-hmm. But as you begin to turn up old stones in books, it might come out where it was there before here, something like that. But I hear reggae as when New Orleans was a baby. Mm-hmm. It was reggae. Yeah. And where were reggae? I guess it was Calypso at that time or something.

And the theory is that some of the radio stations were heard in Jamaica and that they picked up on some of the early sounds. It's hard to hear it today, but that's how the theory goes. Do you have trouble working with some of the, or do you find it difficult to work with some of the older local musicians in trying to produce them here? And trying to be more specific with that. Trying to find the right sound for them, trying to not get too far away from the old sound, because you don't want to just do the old…
